description: Search UK addresses by free-form text — building, street, postcode, organisation, or any combination. Returns a list of suggestions, each with a UDPRN (Royal Mail's per-address ID). Pass a chosen UDPRN to `postio_udprn_lookup` to fetch the full record. Free / non-billable.

max_results.description: Max results to return. Default 10, max 50.

query.description: Search string. Free-form: building, street, postcode, organisation.

name: postio_address_search
